mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or correlation between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp, or correlation between UNRATE changes and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS increases > 2%, or correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals supply-side weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases > 1%, or correlation between INDPRO changes and 5-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL is rising, or the joint effect is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200,000, or correlation between PAYEMS changes and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the past 3 months, the combined signal indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS > 1%, or the joint effect is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary regime, a decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% signals further economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases > 2% during a recession, or correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during recessions.
